selected_problem: After direct PR creation was hard-gated to an expected validated local commit, fresh main could still POST a pull request when the remote head had already drifted before PR creation; the mismatch was only detected from the created PR response, after an avoidable external side effect.
changes: githubCreatePullRequest now reads the remote branch ref before POST and binds that observed head to expectedHeadSha.
Pre-existing remote drift fails closed with PR_CREATE_HEAD_DRIFT before any PR-create POST side effect.
Malformed or failed preflight receipts fail closed before PR creation.
The existing post-create PR response head check remains active to detect races that occur after preflight.
truth_boundaries: This prevents a PR-create side effect when remote drift is already observable before POST.

The preflight GET and PR-create POST are not one atomic GitHub operation; a remote branch can still move after preflight. The retained post-create head receipt check detects such a race but cannot erase an already-created wrong PR.
No claim of external-service compare-and-create atomicity is made.
